decisions.executionNote: Read cards as 4 and 8. Begin elbow-up approach with left gripper closed; first red needs four presses, then confirm.
Continue smooth elbow-up arc toward the first red button, keeping the closed fingers above the surface.
Align the left link6 above first red at a safe hover; finish rotating the fingers vertically downward before pressing.
First red press 1 of 4: descend once with closed fingers, slight visual centering, then dwell at the demonstrated contact height.
First red: release fully to hover, then press 2 of 4 once and dwell. Preserve alignment and elbow-up configuration.
First red: full release followed by press 3 of 4, then a short dwell. Keep the same centered contact.
First red: full release then press 4 of 4 and dwell. No further red-0 presses after this cycle.
Release fourth first-red press and start left-arm retreat. Right arm starts an elbow-up approach toward blue for the first confirmation.
Continue left retreat and right blue approach along separate elbow-up arcs, remaining above all buttons.
Finish left return while right aligns vertically at blue hover. Do not press blue until centered.
Press blue once to confirm the four first-red presses, with left at origin. Center right fingers, descend once, and dwell.
Release blue completely, then move the right arm above the center red while remaining on its own side. Center card requires eight presses.
Finish centering above second red from the right side, settle, then descend for second-red press 1 of 8 and dwell.
Second red press 2 of 8: lift fully to release, descend once to the same contact height, and dwell.
Second red press 3 of 8: full upward release followed by one vertical press and dwell, with both arms staying in their workspaces.
Second red press 4 of 8: fully release upward, then make one vertical press and dwell. Left remains at origin.
Second red press 5 of 8: release fully, make a tiny hover orientation correction, then press once and dwell.
Second red press 6 of 8: full upward release, one downward press to the same height, then dwell.
Second red press 7 of 8: lift to release completely, descend once, and dwell at contact.
Second red press 8 of 8: full release, one final downward press, and dwell. No further red presses; blue confirmation is next.
Release the eighth center-red press fully and traverse rightward at hover toward blue for the second confirmation; restore upright fingers and left origin.
Center above blue, settle, and press it once for the second confirmation after eight center-red presses. Next motion will release and return home.
Release the second blue confirmation and begin a smooth right-arm elbow-up retreat; open the gripper only after clearing the button.
Continue returning right arm along the elbow-up arc, clear of all buttons, while maintaining the left arm at origin.
Finish the right-arm return to origin with decreasing increments and settle both open grippers; no more button contacts.
